notes: Generated session titles have their own setting: Settings → Generate short titles turns them on or off, and Title model chooses Automatic (Claude first, then Codex), Claude (Haiku) or Codex (GPT-6-Luna). Settings says which one is in use, which model made the last title, and why a choice is unavailable. Requested by Brad.

Titles never try a CLI that isn't there: a server without a signed-in Claude Code or Codex shows why in Settings and makes no title calls. Turning titles off also hides the ones already made, so your list matches code-server.
